parameters.help_en: The name of the pipeline job. If you leave this parameter empty, the system automatically generates a name
parameters.help_zh: 工作流任务名字。若为空，则自动生成名字
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to start the pipeline job. Valid values:

true (default): starts the pipeline job.
false: creates the pipeline job and does not start it
parameters.help_zh:
是否直接启动pipelineRun，取值如下：
true代表直接启动（默认）。
false代表只创建run，但先不启动
parameters.name: no_confirm_required

parameters.help_en: The options used to create the pipeline job, which are in the JSON format
parameters.help_zh: 创建工作流任务选项，格式为JSON
parameters.name: options

parameters.help_en: The pipeline ID. You must configure PipelineId or PipelineManifest
parameters.help_zh:
工作流的ID。
PipelineId和PipelineManifest二选一
parameters.name: pipeline_id

parameters.example:
apiVersion: "core/v1"
metadata:
  provider: "1557702098******"
  version: "v1"
  identifier: "my_pipeline"
  name: "source-transform"
spec:
  inputs:
    parameters:
    - name: "execution_maxcompute"
      type: "Map"
  pipelines:
  - apiVersion: "core/v1"
    metadata:
      provider: "pai"
      version: "v1"
      identifier: "data_source"
      name: "data_source"
      displayName: "Read data table-1"
    spec:
      arguments:
        parameters:
        - name: "inputTableName"
          value: "pai_online_project.wumai_data"
        - name: "partition"
          value: "20220101"
        - name: "execution"
          from: "{{inputs.parameters.execution_maxcompute}}"
  - apiVersion: "core/v1"
    metadata:
      provider: "pai"
      version: "v1"
      identifier: "type_transform"
      name: "type_transform"
      displayName: "Type transform-1"
    spec:
      arguments:
        artifacts:
        - name: "inputTable"
          from: "{{pipelines.data_source.outputs.artifacts.outputTable}}"
        parameters:
        - name: "cols_to_double"
          value: "time,hour,pm2,pm10,so2,co,no2"
        - name: "execution"
          from: "{{inputs.parameters.execution_maxcompute}}"
      dependencies:
      - "data_source"
